pairs.why: The two are almost the same, but B's yellow canopy is smoother and softly lit like the real umbrella, while A shows more fabric-weave texture, which the lessons count against.
Same near-twin pair: B's canopy is a little smoother with a soft sheen, closer to the real cards' smooth toy-like surface than A's grainier cloth.
B has slightly less surface texture on the canopy and frill, which matches the smooth but not ultra-smooth finish of the real cards.
B's canopy is smoother, with a soft highlight, while A's yellow dome shows a visible weave; the real umbrella is clean and smooth.

A's gold hour markers tie the dial into the chunky, single-color toy look of the real cards, and it floats with no ground shadow like they do, while B's thin black ticks and cast shadow look more like a real watch.
B is the gold-marker version: more stylized, toy-like and floating, which is closer to the real ring box and scarf than A's grounded watch with black ticks.
A's gold markers and floating pose match the simple, chunky look of the real cards better than B's finer black ticks and cast shadow.
B is the gold-marker, floating version, which reads more like the real cards' bold, simplified objects than A's more realistic watch with black ticks.
